newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia fund denies receiving UMW proposal -paper.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia fund denies receiving UMW proposal -paper.

text.p: Malaysia state investment fund Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB) denied it received a proposal from a third party interested in buying its vehicle concern UMW Holdings Bhd, The Star daily reported on Tuesday.

Privately held Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd said last week it was eyeing a stake in UMW. Sapura's group managing director Shahril Shamsuddin was quoted by the national Bernama news agency as saying that the company has put forward a proposal to the authorities.
"I don't know anything about the proposal except from press reports. There has been no approach from Sapura on the matter," PNB's chief executive officer, Mohamed Hilmey Mohamed was quoted as saying.

UMW makes a wide range of light and heavy equipment for use in the industrial, construction and agricultural sectors. It also assembles and markets passenger and commercial vehicles and related spares.
Sapura controls two listed telecommunications firms, Sapura Telecommunications Bhd and Uniphone Telecommunications Bhd.
Officials at UMW and Sapura could not be immediately contacted.
